survey: A stage spotlight hangs from a metal truss that runs straight across the top of the card. The truss is seen almost level, with its rails horizontal and parallel and its diagonal braces evenly spaced. A round clamp hub hangs under the truss. A short elbow pipe drops from it into a U-shaped yoke. The yoke wraps over the lamp body and pivots on a round knob on the near side. The lamp body is a cylinder turned toward the lower left in a three-quarter view. Its front face is a fairly open ellipse, and its rear end curves away on the right. The ring bands around the body curve the same way as the front rim, so they follow the cylinder's turn. The three lenses (yellow, cyan, red) sit in a cluster on the front face. Each lens is an ellipse squashed to roughly the same degree as the front rim, and they shrink slightly toward the far side. A short cylindrical stub sticks out under the rear of the body, and its rim ellipse matches the downward view of the underside. The light beam comes out along the cylinder's axis toward the lower left. The truss, hub, yoke, body, lenses and beam all agree on one slightly-below, three-quarter camera.
